name: talentswap-db
description: TalentSwap cumulative PostgreSQL database delivery: DB-03 through DB-17.

scripts.db:migrate: pnpm --dir apps/api exec prisma migrate deploy
scripts.db:seed: pnpm --dir apps/api exec prisma db seed
scripts.db:bootstrap: pnpm db:generate && pnpm db:migrate && pnpm db:seed
scripts.db:full-test-docker: docker compose -f docker-compose.db.yml --profile test run --rm db-test
